subject: POC kickoff — scheduling hands-on launchpad and security attendees
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <s.park@stellartech.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed windows + attendees

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. We're excited to get the POC started with StellarTech. To keep momentum I'll propose two kickoff windows for a 90-minute hands-on session (AE + SE + your infra/security + procurement on the same invite for the initial alignment):

- Option A: Tue, Jun 15 — 09:30–11:00 PT
- Option B: Wed, Jun 16 — 11:00–12:30 PT

Agenda (draft attached): quick goals & success criteria (15m), architecture & security review (20m), live demo + integration checklist (40m), next steps & owners (15m).

Can you confirm who from StellarTech should be on the invite for procurement/security so we include them from the start? If neither window works share a couple slots and we'll adapt.

Attachments: POC_Kickoff_Agenda_draft.pdf, Pre-kickoff_checklist.xlsx

Best,
Grace
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

From: Sam Park <s.park@stellartech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya.s@stellartech.com>, Luis Moreno <luis.m@stellartech.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 17:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows + attendees

Hi Grace —

Thanks — both windows look promising. Quick notes from our side:
- Priya (procurement) prefers afternoons, she is available Wed Jun 16 after 1pm PT.
- Luis (security) is in EMEA travel the week of Jun 15 but can dial in Wed Jun 16 at 11:00 PT for the architecture/security segment if that helps.
- Our infra lead (me) can do either slot but I want the hands-on demo to include our SREs (I'll loop them if you confirm the final time).

If Wed Jun 16 is possible, could we split the session slightly: first 45m focused on success criteria + security/architecture (Luis joins), then 45m hands-on demo with SREs? That would help us validate both policy and runbook items.

I'll defer to your SE on whether that split works.

—Sam
Head of Cloud Integrations, StellarTech
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Sam Park <s.park@stellartech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows + attendees

Thanks Sam — splitting the session is fine from an SE perspective. Wed Jun 16 at 11:00 PT works for me, and we can do 11:00–11:45 for security/architecture (Dylan + Luis) and 11:45–13:00 for hands-on with SREs.

Two asks from my side to make the hands-on efficient:
- Can you share one or two representative YAMLs or infra snippets (or link to a public repo) so I can prep a short integration demo?
- Please confirm which SREs will attend so I can reserve runbook slots.

I'll produce a 1-page checklist (pre-flight dev checklist) and update the attached agenda with the split.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <s.park@stellartech.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Priya Suresh <priya.s@stellartech.com>, Luis Moreno <luis.m@stellartech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows + attendees

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick responses. Action items before Wed Jun 16 11:00 PT:

- Sam: please add the SRE names + calendar addresses (or reply-all with their availability) so Dylan can plan runbook slots.
- Priya: note procurement will only need the first 30 minutes for procurement checklist & contracting flags; we'll keep her on the first block and then mark optional for the hands-on.
- Luis: thanks — we'll keep you for the architecture/security block (11:00–11:45). If travel forces a dial-in only that's fine.
- Dylan: please attach the pre-flight checklist and the updated agenda to the calendar invite; Aditya will own the invite creation and add dial-in details.
- Marissa (CS): I'll loop you for post-POC success criteria tracking; we want to map outcome owners in the kickoff.

I'll let Aditya send the invite once I have the SRE list from Sam.

Best,
Grace
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <s.park@stellartech.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Suresh <priya.s@stellartech.com>, Luis Moreno <luis.m@stellartech.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows + attendees

Hi all —

Thanks — I've put the confirmed slot on the calendar: Wed, Jun 16, 2026 11:00–13:00 PT (invite sent) — split as discussed: 11:00–11:45 security/architecture, 11:45–13:00 hands-on.

Invite includes: Grace O'Connor (AE), Dylan Brooks (SE), Aditya Rao (technical lead), Marissa Cole (CS), Sam Park (infra lead), Priya Suresh (procurement), Luis Moreno (security), plus:
- Anil Kapoor <anil.k@stellartech.com> (SRE)
- Hannah Lin <hannah.lin@stellartech.com> (SRE)

Attachments added to invite: POC_Kickoff_Agenda_draft.pdf, Pre-kickoff_checklist.xlsx, Pre-flight_dev_checklist.pdf

Link to shared folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/rdw-3487-poc

If anyone needs a different dial-in or additional attendees please reply to this thread and I'll update the invite. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Cheers,
